question: By what factor does the viscosity of neat [TEPAH][ATA] before absorption exceed that of the [TEPAH][ATA]/NPA/H2O system before absorption?
rendered:
The document does not directly state the viscosity of neat [TEPAH][ATA] before absorption. However, it states that neat ILs can increase their viscosity by several hundredfold upon CO2 absorption. 

The viscosity of the [TEPAH][ATA]/NPA/H2O system before absorption is 14.62 mPa s (Table 1). This is the viscosity of the system before CO2 absorption. 

The viscosity of the [TEPAH][ATA]/NPA/H2O system after CO2 absorption is 6.59 mPa s (Table 1). The viscosity of the system after absorption is lower than before absorption, not higher.
